stage: Final Five Mood Board Pop Quiz

moodboards.entrance_line: I arrive pre-soldered and hot, in SCSI stilettos that beep when tops malfunction.
moodboards.prompt_brief: Torn-magazine cyberpunk collage of a 1990s server room, chrome SCSI stilettos with diagnostic LEDs, solder smoke, CRT glow, circuit-board couture, and queer underground club heat.

moodboards.entrance_line: I arrived late, lacquered, and slightly haunted, like a church pew after a very good divorce.
moodboards.prompt_brief: Gothic fashion collage of a lacquered black church pew, spectral mourning couture, divorce papers as confetti, candle wax, pearls, legal corridors, and post-divorce relief.

moodboards.entrance_line: Hello dolls, I got banned from a lesbian antique mall for licking the Lalique vase and calling it foreplay.
moodboards.prompt_brief: Camp erotic antique-mall collage with opaline drag, a frosted Art Nouveau crystal vase, lipstick on glass, brass keys, dusty mirrors, dealer surveillance, and sapphic pulp atmosphere.

moodboards.entrance_line: Saint Static has entered the building, darling. I’m dressed like a haunted answering machine, and my voicemail is exclusively for handsome men with bad boundaries.
moodboards.prompt_brief: Haunted 1980s collage with answering-machine couture, cassette ruffles, telephone-cord halo, red voicemail lights, Catholic kitsch, VHS static, and handsome men crowding a peephole.

moodboards.entrance_line: Mercy Misdemeanor, reporting for community service in a stolen choir robe and the orthopedic heels God warned me about.
moodboards.prompt_brief: Ecclesiastical civic-punishment collage with a stolen choir robe, reflective service vest, orthopedic platform heels, citation clipboard, trash-grabber scepter, church basement, and veiled traffic cone.
